description: This file defines an object CategoryIconMapper that provides utility functions for mapping backend category names to icon resource IDs and generating content descriptions for accessibility within an Android frontend application.

classes.name: CategoryIconMapper
classes.description: A singleton object that maps category names to icon resource IDs and provides content descriptions for screen readers.

methods.name: iconResForCategory
methods.description: Returns a drawable resource ID based on the input category name, falling back to a generic icon if category is unknown or blank.

methods.name: contentDescriptionForCategory
methods.description: Creates a user-friendly content description string for accessibility, appending 'category' to the sanitized category name.
